name: Swipe Row
description: A row whose hidden actions are revealed by swiping to the side; a full swipe performs the action itself.
interactionNotes: Drag the row to the side to bring the actions out from the edge. If you pull too little it springs back; if you pass the threshold it stays there. Pull all the way and release to run the action directly. With a keyboard, the arrow keys open and close the row.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the row itself.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions that come out when you swipe.

props.name: actionColor
props.description: Background of the action area.

props.name: drawerColor
props.description: Color of the drawer, beneath the row.

props.name: rowColor
props.description: Color of the row itself.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color of the row.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the row.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius.

props.name: actionWidth
props.description: Width of each action.

props.name: direction
props.description: The direction the row moves as it opens; the drawer comes out from the opposite edge.

props.name: snapBounce
props.description: Spring bounce when it snaps into place.

props.name: resistance
props.description: Resistance against over-dragging.

props.name: collapseMs
props.description: Duration of the collapse after an action runs.

props.name: commitAt
props.description: From what percentage of the width a drag counts as a full swipe.

props.name: fullSwipe
props.description: Whether a full swipe runs the action directly.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the row opens or closes.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called after the swipe completes; the moment the action is committed.

props.name: onAction
props.description: A simpler version of `onCommit`; for when only the result matters.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Rows open and close one after another by themselves; for a showcase card.

props.name: closeOnAction
props.description: Whether the row closes itself after an action is chosen.

props.name: haptic
props.description: A short vibration on touch devices at the moment the swipe commits.

props.name: label
props.description: The default row text, when you have not passed anything to `rows`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the root.

tips: The first action in the list is the primary one — the one a full swipe runs. The rest are laid out after it.
With `dismiss` on an action, that one also collapses the row; without it, the drawer only closes.
The texts are Persian and the rest of the behavior is the default — including the `direction` default, which brings the drawer out from the right.
`onCommit` is called after the collapse animation finishes — if you change the list right there, the user will not see a jump.
